podcast.body: Released in late summer 2010, this debut full-length album was a significant hit, spawning five singles and launching the band's career. Several other successful records followed. "And late in the summer of 2010, the group released their first full album, which they called Pick It Up The Pieces. And BAM! That record hit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
